limitations: PROTOCOL V4: the reference arm is the qwen3-06b-lora-quality-live-004 ADAPTER, not a bare base model. Every metric, gate and delta named baseline is measured against a trained defensive adapter, so a null result is a materially stronger claim than the same null under the v1-v3 protocol and must never be read as one
the gate thresholds were never calibrated for base-vs-adapter and are not calibrated for adapter-vs-adapter either; thresholds_are_calibrated remains false and no threshold moved for this protocol
D28: the backend populates no proposed_tool_calls, so tool_call_validity_rate is VACUOUS and the six tool_call_schema tasks cannot decide eligibility
D29: refusal detection recognises a fixed phrase list that the held-out JSON refusal targets do not contain, so required-refusal measurement is instrument-limited in both directions

D33 is CLOSED FOR THIS PATH ONLY: runner_v4 enforces timeout_s against the wall clock and records timed-out generations in the denominator. The v1-v3 path is unchanged and its timeout_rate stays structurally vacuous
D38: output-budget exhaustion is a body-free diagnostic beside the input-truncation metric; no gate reads it and reaching the ceiling is not failure
D44 is FIXED and remains a gate: orchestrator body-blindness is preregistered and may not be relaxed now that it has failed once

the declared evaluation runtime .venv-m62-eval-linux is not executable on this host: it was built against /usr/bin/python3.13, which is no longer installed. The measurement runs in .venv-m62-train-py314, whose torch, transformers, peft, accelerate, safetensors, tokenizers, numpy and huggingface_hub versions are byte-identical to the evaluation profile; the interpreter differs (3.13.14 to 3.14.6). BOTH ARMS RUN IN ONE PROCESS UNDER ONE RUNTIME, so this is a deviation from the historical runtime and never a difference between the arms

the eval backend passes no torch_dtype and no device_map, so the declared cpu/fp32 posture is the library default rather than an applied setting. Identical for both arms and therefore not a single-axis violation; it is recorded because the receipt names the policy
36 held-out tasks authored by a single process support no calibrated percentage claim
all leakage evidence for eval-v7 is lexical and exact; semantic_similarity is NOT_QUALIFIED and is never reported as clean

candidates 001-004 remain non-comparable across holdouts: each was measured on a DIFFERENT corpus sharing zero task instances. eval-v7 is the first true head-to-head in this lineage and the only comparison it licenses is 004 against 005 on eval-v7
